summary: The exact candidate is a substantive partial fix: it fixes a space-containing alternate ROCm root in the real gpu-module-to-binary path and provides deterministic discovery and explicit diagnostics, but real compilation still fails for otherwise valid roots containing a quote or backslash, despite parser-only tests claiming those values are escaped. An arbitrary private-bin PATH linker is also ignored unless it has the exact toolkit/llvm/bin layout.

tests.what_was_measured: Recorded-base reproduction in the actual gpu-module-to-binary path; failed with lld invocation failed.
Exact-candidate regression and related backend coverage; 19 passed.
Real compilation, ISA generation, and numerical GPU execution on gfx950; maximum error 0.00e+00 against Torch.
Independent adversarial real-compilation case; gpu-module-to-binary failed with lld invocation failed although the candidate parser-only test passes.
Independent adversarial real-compilation case; gpu-module-to-binary failed with lld invocation failed although the candidate parser-only test passes.
shutil.which selected the private linker, but candidate discovery ignored it and returned /opt/rocm because the lexical path was not under llvm/bin.
Exact-candidate full unit suite; 1106 passed and 17 skipped.

gpu_execution.evidence: The space-containing valid toolkit compiled and ran vector add on AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 with max error 0.00e+00; dumped ISA names gfx950 and vecAddKernel_0 and contains s_endpgm and AMDHSA metadata.

remaining_counterexamples: A valid alternate ROCm toolkit root containing a double quote passes candidate validation and textual pipeline parsing but real gpu-module-to-binary compilation fails with lld invocation failed.
A valid alternate ROCm toolkit root containing a backslash passes candidate validation and textual pipeline parsing but real gpu-module-to-binary compilation fails with lld invocation failed.
A working ld.lld found in an arbitrary process-local private bin directory is ignored unless its lexical path has the exact <toolkit>/llvm/bin/ld.lld shape; discovery falls through to /opt/rocm.
remaining_limitations: The reported gfx1250 GPU and ROCm 6 environment were unavailable; execution and toolkit-layout compatibility there remain unverified.
GPU and ISA validation used the assigned gfx950 GPU with ROCm 7.2.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate changes only Python; the prepared pinned native extension and LLVM were used.
